messages:
leo_support: Escalating CedarMap (org: 'cedarmap-pilot') — SSO step failing intermittently during onboarding; our login webhook returns 504 for ~30% of users. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4987
may_cs: Oof. Is activation blocked or can they continue without SSO? Renewal risk?
leo_support: Blocked for customers using SSO, some are bypassing with invite links. Renewal risk: elevated if >12h.
sam_csm: Ill own customer comms. Plan: immediate ack + clear workaround (temp invite flow) + 10:30am CT bridge with eng. Requesting a daily status cadence until fix.
rana_eng: Triage: auth-proxy times out due to upstream IdP retries after our redirect change. Patch will add IdP retry-debounce and a circuit-breaker. Canary ETA 90m. In meantime we can route their org to auth-hotfix variant.
ops_bot: Canary rollout scheduled: job 99220 for auth-proxy-hotfix. Monitor: https://ci.redwood.com/99220
may_cs: Comm plan draft to send to CedarMap PM: 1) Acknowledge + apology (now) 2) Workaround: use direct invite links OR set "allow-invite-bypass" in org settings 3) ETA: ~1.5-2h for canary, hourly updates 4) Offer dedicated onboarding coordinator + credit if >6h 5) Request permission to switch their auth routing to hotfix path (non-disruptive).
sam_csm: Adding a short ops blurb for their SREs — @rana_eng please confirm syntax.
rana_eng: Ops snippet to enable invite bypass via API:
curl -X PATCH https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/cedarmap-pilot/settings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" \
  -d '{"allow_invite_bypass":true}'
I can also enable hotfix routing on our side if they prefer.
leo_support: Updated ticket with workaround and monitoring check: auth.504.rate and org.login-errors. Will mute auto-retries client-side for their org.
may_cs: Sending ack now and scheduling the 10:30am CT bridge. I've flagged renewal_risk=ELEVATED and will update the tracker if >12h. Please post hourly updates in this thread. :pray:
